samples.summary: `sheets export` is the one result-producing command that never goes through the new `parseOutputFormat` guard, so `--format bogus` is silently accepted there while every other command now errors
samples.evidence: Every other `output()` call site was converted to validate first (e.g. `packages/cli/src/commands/sheets-import.ts:50`). `packages/cli/src/commands/sheets-export.ts:45-46` instead calls `detectFormat(file, localOpts.fileFormat)` and then `formatCsv`/`formatJson` directly, never reading or validating the global `opts.format`. Result: `wafflebase sheets export id out.csv --format bogus` exits 0 and writes the file, while `wafflebase sheets cells get id --format bogus` now exits 1 with INVALID_FORMAT. If the intent is that the global flag is meaningless for this command that is defensible, but nothing in the code or the new §8.1 doc text says so, and the guard is reachable-around here.

samples.summary: The design doc still advertises `--format yaml` (three places) but `parseOutputFormat` now hard-rejects it with INVALID_FORMAT
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md:82 ("YAML (`--format yaml`)"), :373 ("`--format json|table|csv|yaml` (default: json)") and :647 ("Format dispatcher (json | table | csv | yaml)") all promise a `yaml` output format. `packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:7` defines `OUTPUT_FORMATS = ['json','table','csv']`, so after this change `--format yaml` fails with `INVALID_FORMAT` on every command. The same file now also states at :724-728 that an unsupported `--format` is rejected, so the doc contradicts itself. Previously `format()` fell through the switch and printed `undefined`, i.e. it never worked — but this change turns a documented capability into a hard error and the doc was not reconciled. The docs lane only checks that backticked *paths* resolve, so nothing catches this.

samples.summary: Out-of-diff consumer comment asserts as verified present fact the very defect this PR fixes (`status` ignores `--format json` and prints prose), and it is the stated justification for that module's design
samples.evidence: scripts/agent/hunt-workspace.mjs:15-20: "The obvious design is to run `wafflebase status --format json` ... It does not work: `status` ignores `--format json` and prints prose ... That is ground-truth defect #9 ... Verified empirically, not assumed." After this change `status` emits JSON with `loggedIn`, so the rationale is stale and the harness keeps its crude substring collision scan for a reason that no longer holds. The identical claim is repeated in the top-level design doc docs/design/harness-engineering.md:1482-1485. Neither was updated by this diff (`.trusted/scripts/agent/hunt-workspace.mjs:17` is a pristine baseline copy and presumably must not be edited).

samples.summary: `ctx switch` still emits prose to stderr and `process.exit(1)` for the same no-session condition that `ctx list` now reports as a structured `NOT_LOGGED_IN` error, leaving the two sibling commands inconsistent
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/ctx.ts:94-97 keeps `console.error('Not logged in. Run `wafflebase login`.')` + `process.exit(1)` while the new `NotLoggedInError` (ctx.ts:35) is used only by `ctx list`. `ctx switch` also uses `process.exit()` rather than `process.exitCode`, so it terminates before any flush/finalization that `outputError` callers rely on. The diff's own comment (ctx.ts:75-77) acknowledges the divergence; docs/design/cli.md:712-714 declares it intentional for acknowledgement-only commands, but the error path is not an acknowledgement — agents that branch on the JSON error body get nothing parseable from `ctx switch`.

samples.summary: Three new exports appear to have no consumer outside their own module, which the knip lane flags as unused exports/exported types
samples.evidence: `OUTPUT_FORMATS` (packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:7) is referenced only inside formatter.ts; `WorkspaceRow` (packages/cli/src/commands/ctx.ts:11) and `StatusPayload` (packages/cli/src/commands/status.ts) are exported types used only in their declaring files. knip.json:25-28 makes `src/**` and `test/**` the cli project with `src/bin.ts` + tests as entries, and no test imports these three (test/output.test.ts imports `parseOutputFormat`/`InvalidFormatError`; test/status.test.ts imports `buildStatus`/`NOT_LOGGED_IN_MESSAGE`).
